run_GetCommandOutput: run a shell command and capture its stdout output as a list of stripped lines
run_GetSvnInfo: run svn info to extract the project name and current SVN workspace root path
run_GetSvnTrunk: run GetSvnInfo and return the current SVN workspace trunk root path
run_IsInGTestSvn: run a check to determine if the current directory is inside the googletest SVN workspace
run_IsInGMockSvn: run a check to determine if the current directory is inside the googlemock SVN workspace
